operation.summary: Reports a URI suspected of containing phishing content to be reviewed.
operation.description: Reports a URI suspected of containing phishing content to be reviewed. Once the report review is complete, its result can be found in the Cloud Security Command Center findings dashboard for Phishing Protection. If the result verifies the existence of malicious phishing content, the site will be added the to [Google's Social Engineering lists](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/6350487/) in order to protect users that could get exposed to this threat in the future.
